# Fictional example: Team meeting notes organizer

This is a demonstration only. It contains no real customers or validation results.

We want to turn pasted meeting notes into action items and identify which items need a named owner.

The first version accepts plain text only. A user reviews extracted items before copying them into an existing task system. The app does not send messages or change external projects automatically.

We plan to use an existing language model to organize text and structured judgments to check whether action items lack an owner, deadline or acceptance criteria. Users can edit every result.

A screen prototype exists. No external users have tried it, and no one has measured accuracy, time savings or sustained use.

Questions to validate: Are meeting notes complete enough? Is review faster than organizing items manually? Can different teams use the same fields and workflow?
